q_wand_awakening.title: Wand Awakening
q_wand_awakening.desc: Speak with Kestrin in the courtyard and practice casting your Basic Cast and Stun Bolt on the Training Dummies.

q_spider_infestation.title: The Whispering Woods
q_spider_infestation.desc: The Raven Woods is crawling with venomous Black Weavers. Defeat 5 Black Weavers to protect the castle grounds.

q_dark_monolith.title: Shatter the Dark Shard
q_dark_monolith.desc: A corrupted Dark Shard has emerged near Lake Lunra. Gather other wizards, shatter its obsidian core, and collect the ancient drops.
